segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: A blank check company with no operations or revenues, seeking a business combination with a target business.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, management has determined that there is only one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The company has no operating revenue; it earns interest on IPO and private placement proceeds held in trust.
revenueModel.evidence: We will generate non-operating income in the form of interest income from the proceeds derived from the Initial Public Offering and Private Placement (as defined below).
